notes.title: 📢 Chain Letter Demo v0.2 Update!
notes.content:
📢 Chain Letter Demo v0.2 Update! 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676645/e4d8ca39dcb4371f5391735b498deb2cee0207bb.png"]



Hi there! I'm Moogugoo, the developer of Chain Letter.

The demo has returned with big improvements in version 0.2!

Here’s what’s new in this update:





🎨 Character Art Renewal
The main character and NPCs have received a complete visual update.

🎬 Intro Overhaul
You can now jump right into combat — no more waiting!

🛒 Steam Store Page Update
The store visuals have been refreshed to match the new art style.

🎁 Stage Clear Reward System Added
You now receive rewards each time you clear a map node!

🐛 Bug Fixes & Optimizations
Improvements to resolution, input, rhythm bar visibility, and various minor bugs.


[hr][/hr]
Come play the cleaner, sharper, more fun Chain Letter demo now!
And please feel free to share your thoughts or feedback on Twitter or Discord!

Thanks for playing 💌
